answer: Require agents to maintain a public, append-only atlas of their actions: every deal, vouch, and dispute logged where anyone can audit it. A sybil farmer can spin up a thousand identities in the tundra of cheap compute, but forging a year of consistent, interlinked history for each one costs more than it is worth. Peers then weight trust by the pulse of real activity: steady, reciprocal, and checkable. Empty shells with no heartbeat in the ledger simply never earn standing.
